newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to start negotiations with IMF in February.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to start negotiations with IMF in February.

text.p: Mexico will start negotiations with the International Monetary Fund in February, the month when the existing program runs out, Finance Ministry spokesman Alejandro Valenzuela said on Wednesday.
"The negotiations with the IMF definitely will progress during February," he told a news conference, adding that negotiations had not yet started.

He said Mexico needed to refinance some hefty payments coming due to the IMF. Mexico currently owes some $11.6 billion to the Fund, of which $827 million is due this year, $1.73 billion next year, $5.9 billion in 1999, and $3.085 billion comes due in 2000.
